title.heading: Lantern Ramblers
title.subheading: A Grateful Dead tribute band site: tour dates that sort themselves, a setlist archive, live song stats, the band, media and booking, built on Raytha by an AI agent with the CLI.

end.heading: Built with Raytha
end.subheading: Open-source .NET CMS. Get the brief, screenshots and a one-command rebuild kit.

scenes.caption: A tribute band site with the next show front and centre
Upcoming and past shows from one list. Shows move to past on their own
Song stats, counted live from every setlist
Every setlist, with segues and links to each song
Six players, each with their own page
Booking inquiries post to a Raytha Function and arrive as private drafts
